description: Get the PDF of a credit note (Gutschrift), e.g. to show, check or forward it. Read-only preview: it is fetched with preventSendBy, so it never marks the credit note as sent (versendet) or changes its status. The result holds the file's metadata and a resource link; the client loads the file itself via resources/read, its content is never put into the text. To save a copy to disk or as a download link use sevdesk_document_save (available with SEVDESK_OUTPUT_DIR or on a remote server). Find the id with the credit note list tools first.

id.description: sevDesk id of the document (not its number such as RE-1001).

name: sevdesk_credit_note_pdf
title: Get a credit note PDF
